"Institutionalizing" prompts, context, and agent capabilities means establishing explicit rules, contracts, and boundaries, rather than relying on the model's intrinsic "alignment intuition." tn8h9e:182: High autonomy and long time horizons are two key characteristic dimensions on which Harness Engineering focuses. High autonomy means AI systems require less explicit human intervention when executing complex tasks, directly amplifying the potential impact of incorrect decisions; long time horizons mean system state accumulates across multiple sessions and contexts, making context management, state consistency, and memory decay increasingly prominent. Tsinghua University's 79-page report builds a governance framework specifically around these two dimensions, reflecting deep insight into real-world AI Agent deployment scenarios.
